name: spectral-freeze
description:
Freeze: hold the sound of one instant for as long as the switch is on.

A frozen bin keeps its magnitude.  Its phase keeps turning at the rate it
was turning when the freeze began, which is what keeps the pitch of the
held sound; a phase that stood still would buzz at the frame rate instead.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
